title: Variance under Boolean duality
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and define its dual by $f^*(x)=-f(-x)$. Then $\operatorname{Var}(f^*)=\operatorname{Var}(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
